acceptance.given: Before evaluation-matrix execution, the Toolchain matrix manifest is loaded and validated.

oracle.expected: Validation reports exactly six Matrix Case records, each with a materially distinct definition or setup, and enumerates all six IDs with distinctness evidence.
forbidden: Fewer or more than six Matrix Cases are established.
Two or more cases are not materially distinct.
oracle.observable: Matrix-manifest validation output and six-case distinctness report

acceptance.then: Execution is permitted only after the six-case structural invariant is proven.
acceptance.when: The evaluation matrix is prepared for execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run matrix-manifest validation against five, seven, or duplicate/non-distinct cases; it must fail the six-case invariant.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and expose an independent validation result proving exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases before execution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing manifest fields while rejecting violations of the six-case/distinctness constraint.

slice_hint.state_transition: matrix manifest unvalidated -> six-case/distinctness validation recorded -> execution permitted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A machine-readable result lists exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases and validation succeeds.

acceptance.given: A replay result is produced or consumed by the Toolchain replay pipeline with its evidence bundle available.

oracle.expected: The replay-result artifact records association with the complete Current Snapshot identity and required contents, and validation rejects absent or partial snapshot bindings.
forbidden: A replay result is produced without a complete Current Snapshot binding.
The binding covers only a partial Current Snapshot.
oracle.observable: Replay-result validation output and serialized metadata containing the complete Current Snapshot binding

acceptance.then: The replay result is consumable only after complete Current Snapshot binding is validated.
acceptance.when: A replay result is produced or consumed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Replay a result artifact with the Current Snapshot removed or truncated; validation must fail closed and identify incomplete binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require replay-result serialization and validation to carry a complete Current Snapshot binding.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay-result fields while making complete Current Snapshot association mandatory.

slice_hint.state_transition: replay result unbound/partial -> complete snapshot association validated -> result accepted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation proves the result references a complete Current Snapshot and rejects absent or partial bindings.

acceptance.given: A verdict is issued by the Toolchain evaluation path after validator execution.

oracle.expected: The verdict artifact contains a traceable current source identity tied to real execution evidence; assistant-only prose cannot satisfy the check.
forbidden: A verdict is emitted without a current source identity reference.
The verdict is accepted solely from assistant prose without execution evidence.
oracle.observable: Serialized verdict and execution record showing current source identity and producing command

acceptance.then: The verdict is accepted only when current source identity and real execution evidence are traceable.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate a verdict with missing, stale, or mismatched source identity; governance validation must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require verdict validation to include current source identity and linked real execution evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep verdict schema compatibility while rejecting missing identity or execution evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: verdict pending identity trace -> identity and execution checked -> verdict accepted/rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A machine validator links each verdict to current source identity and a real command execution record.

acceptance.given: The candidate validator's FR-3 support policy and declared verification procedure are available.

oracle.expected: An independently executed Toolchain verification artifact evaluates the support policy against its rules and records a separate pass/fail result.
forbidden: Support policy is accepted without independent verification.
oracle.observable: Independent support-policy verification result referencing the evaluated policy rules

acceptance.then: FR-3 support policy is verified only when an independent check records its result.
acceptance.when: Validating the candidate validator for FR-3.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run governance-policy verification with the independent-check record missing or identical to the authoring result; it must fail the independence requirement.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an independently produced support-policy verification artifact and reject acceptance when it is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve policy declarations while requiring an additional independent verification record.

slice_hint.state_transition: support policy pending independent check -> independent result recorded -> policy accepted/rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A separate validator invocation emits an independently attributable support-policy result required for acceptance.
